thread:
Ravi: Quick poll: who I mean, who wants to join the Great Office Plant Naming Ceremony this Friday at 4pm? :seedling: 
Elena: Wait we have a plant now? Did it arrive with an official onboarding doc? :eyes: 
Marcus: Its on my desk. Its currently labeled Plant A on a sticky. Clearly insufficient. 
Ivy: Ooh I call dibs on naming rights if I bring biodegradable confetti. 
Ravi: Rules: 1) Bring a name proposal 2) One sentence origin story 3) Winner gets to choose the plants nickname for a week. 
Elena: Proposal: Sir Chlorophyll the Third. Origin: Survived two heavy meetings and one near-coffee spill. 
Marcus: Proposal: Monica (because she rearranged my desk and is judging me). Origin: Mysterious past in the supply closet. 
Ivy: Proposal: Leaf Erickson. Origin: Explorer vibes. 
ops-bot: Reminder set for Friday 15:45 and a tiny celebratory GIF will be posted to this channel. :robot_face: 
Elena: Can we have ceremonial tiny hat? I will craft. 
Ravi: Tiny hat = must. Also debating whether to have a brief oath. Suggestions? 
Marcus: I pledge to water with attention and not over-fertilize. Dramatic flourish optional. 
Ivy: Can we add I will not re-pot without consensus as a clause? Very important. 
Elena: Also can we vote on whether the plant is allowed near the window (sun rights)? :sun_with_face: 
Ravi: Voting method: sticky notes in the plant pot (biodegradable only) OR anonymous survey. Which do we prefer? 
Marcus: Sticky notes in pot is destiny. Very on-brand. 
Ivy: If anyone cannot make it, drop your name + one-line proposal here and we'll enter it in the ceremonial ballot. 
Elena: Pre-submitting: The Office Fern (backstory: rescued from a meeting room napkin). 
Ravi: Pre-submitting: Captain Photosynth. 
Marcus: Pre-submitting: Kevin (simple, effective). Photo: <https://files.redwood.internal/plant/captain-photosynth.jpg> 
Ivy: I'll bring a tiny badge and the biodegradable confetti. Also a printable translatable oath in case we need it. 
Ravi: Ops-bot will livestream a 30s highlights clip for posterity. The plant will be immortalized in #all-hands lore if we sign the leaf. 
ops-bot: Livestream ready. Posting RSVP thread to #help and calendar invite to attendees. :sparkles: 
Elena: Legendary. See you Friday, plant enthusiasts. Also, if anyone wants watering duty schedule, sign up after the ceremony. 
Marcus: Agree on watering rota. No ghost caretakers. 
Ivy: This is now an official Redwood tradition. Recording it for the handbook. :notebook:
